regime_context: The detector shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative rotation: only Banks are both ranked first (score 0.907) and trend-gate eligible, while everything else is ineligible except a deeply late-cycle Innovative Pharma line. The absolute-trend gate has NOT held on China A-shares historically (gate_helps=false), and the backtest verdict explicitly treats this market as mean-reverting and this allocation as display/experimental — so any lean here is low-conviction by construction.
emerging_watch: Watch Gold Miners (unscorable, no ETF proxy, rank 2 but eligible=false): if it becomes trend-gate eligible with breadth expanding above 0.4 and durability recovering toward 0.5 while Banks' absorption stays below 0.4, that would mark a CONFIRMED leadership handoff worth re-evaluating; until then it remains an ineligible second-place challenger only.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the single eligible theme and the one-narrative dominant leader (score 0.907, breadth 0.833, hurst_tag 'trend', durability_bar 0.75). This supports a qualified continuation lean — leadership is broad and cohesive, not a thin outlier. However, the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history, so the ONLY validated edge is absent; this is a focus lens, not alpha, and must be flagged with realistic humility.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (crowding_z 1.82, crowded=true) and the dominant one-narrative structure carries concentrated drawdown risk; in a mean-reverting tape the very conditions that make Banks the leader (extreme concentration, crowdedness) are the historical setup for the gate to whipsaw and reverse.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS breaks below its 50-day average while lagging the CSI 300 by more than 3% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: The only other eligible theme is Innovative Pharma & CXO (eligible=true) but it sits at rank 9 with a weak score (0.16), mixed hurst_tag, and heavy crowding (z 1.35, crowded=true). It is nominally trend-gate eligible but has no momentum leadership, no breadth (0.429), and no durability — the trend gate passing a weak, crowded, non-leader is the kind of condition that offers no drawdown edge on a market where the gate already failed historically.
theses.dissent: A rotation toward Healthcare defensives could give this the only non-Bank eligible line a stealth bid if the one-narrative Banks trade unwinds; avoiding it forgoes a potential rotation beneficiary.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ advances more than 5% on expanding breadth above 0.6 while Banks stall for five consecutive sessions before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
